## Quickstart

```
make setup      # python 3.12 venv via uv + deps (torch is big, give it a few minutes)
cp .env.example .env   # then add your ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and LANGSMITH_API_KEY
make seed
make run        # or: make cli
```
